三角洲航运受控
第三方船只面临更多困难
中国报刊表示担忧，前往兴公（音译）（Hsingkong，江苏长江北岸重要沿海地区）的航运将受到当地军方的严格控制，致使第三方航运利益方几乎没有机会获得业务。
本报数周前曾刊登过一则报道，现有一则报告证实了该报道的内容，指出该地区有许多小船和舢板，其操作人员强迫其他载有 destined for 第三方轮船货物的船只驶往巡逻舢板上的人员所偏好的其他轮船。
据称，客运交通也被垄断。不乘坐指定轮船的旅客会受到搜查，一些停泊在兴公（音译）外海的第三方轮船无法装载货物，最近有一艘此类轮船返回上海时，几乎未装载本可从兴公（音译）运至此地的货物。
去年，从该地区向上海运输皮革、鬃毛和其他土产已受到控制。据称，包括猪在内的牲畜运输正得到有效控制。

日本航运在中国港口占据首位

三月份，日本旗在中国各港口的外国航运中再次大幅跃进，明确占据第一位，远远领先于英国旗。1939年3月，中国各港口进出港船舶总吨位为2,552,135吨，其中934,000吨悬挂旭日旗。日本在华航运量较上月增加111,000吨。
三月份，英国在中国海港的航运量也增加了74,000吨，但总计仅为791,000吨。虽然日本旗在所有华北港口占据主导地位，但英国旗在华南港口仍保持领先。在 reviewed 月份内，日本和英国航运合计占中国各港口所有外国航运的70%。
在其他国家中，挪威以209,000吨、德国以141,000吨的航运量分别位居第三和第四。第五位是中国航运，包括在各“傀儡”政权旗帜下的舢板，总计138,000吨。这部分中国航运业务大部分由华北港口办理。
中国所有港口的外国航运总量中，仅上海一地就占了一半，3月份达到1,264,000吨。渤海湾港口和青岛共计1,031,000吨，其中青岛贡献304,000吨；天津277,000吨；秦皇岛229,000吨。与二月相比，航运量的增长全部来自上海和北方港口。
华南港口的航运量再次下降，这主要是由于日本海军和空军对中国控制下的港口重新发动行动所致。在这些港口中，汕头以185,000吨的总航运量居首。厦门的外国航运量仅为79,000吨。

Then, a short time after Mr.
Murata's return to Tokyo, the Tokyo
Nichi Nichi Shimbun published on
October 11, 1938, the following:
"Preparations for the creation of
the national policy shipping com-
pany in China tasked with the
execution of the Japanese national
policy at sea just as the North
China Development Company and
the Central China Development
Promotion Company are tasked
with the similar duties on land, are
steadily progressing, and it is likely
that the giant shipping company
will be established by the end of
this year."
Actually the Nisshin Kisen Kaisha
has been established and operating
for the past several months along
the lines elaborated by Mr. Murata
but its success in the way of a
monopoly has been only on totally
protected routes: the Yangtse and
the Pearl Rivers.
Single Management
"Major lines to be brought under
the management of the proposed
shipping firm are, as a principle,"
the Nichi Nichi Shimbun said, "the
Japanese regular lines between
China and Japan, along the Chinese
coast and up the Yangtse River;
including both the government
ordered lines and the free lines.
"In view of the importance of the
freight to be transported on these
lines, however, a part of the tramp
routes concerned will also be placed
under the control of the new con-
cern."
This "determined shipping war
with Great Britain on the Yangtse"
envisaged by Mr. Murata has been
in progress for some months past.
It means that the Yangtse River
has been kept closed, and in all
probability will be kept closed until
the Nisshin Kisen Kaisha has suf-
ficient tonnage of the proper draft
to handle all the freight and pas-
sengers offered on the river from
Shanghai to Hankow.
The "serious future condition"
that is now dictating present
happenings, shipping men aver, is
the key to the seemingly purpose-
less regulations and miscellaneous
hindrances hampering the routine
operation of third power shipping
along the China Coast.
It is in line with the plan to make
effective the Nisshin Kisen Kaisha
monopoly, shipping experts declare,
that the Japanese are losing no
opportunity to convince foreign, and
particularly British ship-owners,
that to wage a determined fight
against the Japanese program, even
if eventually successful, is not going
to be profitable.

随后，在村田先生返回东京后不久，《东京日日新闻》于1938年10月11日发表了以下内容：
“旨在执行日本海上国家政策的在华国家政策航运公司的筹备工作正在稳步进行，正如华北开发公司和华中振兴公司在陆地上承担类似职责一样，这家巨型航运公司很可能在今年年底前成立。”
实际上，日清轮船公司已按照村田先生阐述的方针成立并运营了数月，但其垄断成功仅限于完全受保护的航线：长江和珠江。
统一管理
《日日新闻》称：“原则上，拟议中的航运公司将管理的主要航线是日本与中国之间、沿中国海岸以及溯长江而上的日本定期航线；包括政府指令航线和自由航线。”
“然而，鉴于这些航线上运输货物的重要性，部分相关的不定期航线也将置于新公司的控制之下。”
村田先生设想的这场“与英国在长江上的坚决航运战”已进行了数月。这意味着长江一直处于关闭状态，并且极有可能继续保持关闭，直到日清轮船公司拥有足够适当吃水深度的吨位，以处理上海至汉口间提供的所有货物和乘客。
航运人士声称，目前支配着当下事态发展的“严峻未来局势”，是看似毫无目的的规章和各种阻碍第三方势力船只沿中国海岸常规运营的障碍的关键所在。
航运专家宣称，为了使日清轮船公司的垄断生效，日本人正不失时机地让外国、特别是英国船主相信，即使最终成功，与日本计划进行坚决斗争也是无利可图的。

This profitable operation, however,
to a considerable extent hinges on
the Nisshin Kisen Kaisha's ability
to squeeze business in some of the
most profitable commodities and
ports from the old entrenched
British firms.
Along the ports of the China
Coast, in spite of the strenuous
efforts the Japanese, with the co-
operation of their armed forces and
their puppet governments, have been
making during the past few months,
the big foreign firms have con-
tinued their operations and in some
cases actually expanded.
Not A Success
For the present, it must, there-
fore, be concluded, the program as
outlined by Mr. Murata last Septem-
ber, although competently and
actively pushed by his subordinates
and his country's armed forces, has
not been a success. It is still too
early to judge, however, as the
Japanese are handicapped by a lack
of tonnage: a disadvantage they
are making every effort to overcome.
In the case of the Yangtse River,
the Japanese success is also relative.
They have been able to exclude
third-power vessels by an arbitrary
declaration of power, but in so doing
they have also penalized them-
selves.
With the coming of Spring, and
the rise in the water level of the
Yangtse, some local commercial and
shipping observers anticipate that
the river will be re-opened.
The chief factor in the re-open-
ing, these men believe, is the
possibility that the Japanese may
this year have available a fleet of
deep sea vessels for service on the
river during the high water period.

然而，这一有利可图的行动在相当程度上取决于日清汽船株式会社（Nisshin Kisen Kaisha）能否从根基深厚的英国老牌商行手中夺取某些利润最丰厚的商品和港口的业务。

在中国沿海各港口，尽管日本人在过去几个月中在其武装部队和傀儡政府的配合下做出了艰苦努力，但大型外商公司仍继续运营，在某些情况下甚至实际上扩大了业务。

并未成功

因此，目前必须得出结论，村田先生（Mr. Murata）去年九月所概述的计划，虽然在其下属及其国家武装部队的得力且积极的推动下实施，但并未取得成功。不过，现在下判断还为时过早，因为日本人受到吨位不足的制约：他们正竭尽全力克服这一劣势。

在长江方面，日本人的成功也是相对的。他们能够通过武断地宣示权力来排除第三国船只，但这样做也使他们自己受到了惩罚。

随着春季的到来和长江水位的上涨，一些当地商业和航运观察家预计长江将重新开放。这些人认为，重新开放的主要因素是日本今年可能在丰水期拥有一支可供长江服务使用的远洋船队。

OWNERS OF JAPANESE TRAMP STEAMERS MEET TO DISCUSS

According to information secured by foreign
circles, owners of Japanese tramp steamers held a meeting
sometime this week at the Astor House to discuss plans
of co-operation in the shipping business along the
Yangtsze.

The other day it was reported that the object

affiliated with the Central China Development Company to
control navigation along the Yangtsze. About 50 persons
attended the meeting, each of whom is the owner of two
ships.

It is learned that the Japanese tramp steamers

authorities to sail in various waters, but this permission
has now been withdrawn. For this reason, owners of
these steamers held the meeting to discuss the situation.

据悉，日本散货轮船此前曾被日本海军和军事当局允许在各水域航行，但该许可现已被撤销。因此，这些轮船的船东举行会议讨论局势。

this locality shows that he originally resided at 86 Rue
Marcel Tillot, but removed about two months ago to somewhere
in the vicinity of Jessfield Village. His brief
antecedents are as follows:-

with the result he gained the confidence of his Japanese

others named Wong(王 ) and Zau(邵 ), established a

602, 160 Avenue Edward VII. This company is a branch of
the "Shanghai Inland Steam Launch Company", North Soochow

Standard and other local newspapers :-

NAVIGATION ALONG THE YANGTZE

The Lower Yangtze from the Kiangyin Forts
upwards has been closed to navigation since the fall of
Nanking and Hangchow, but Japanese goods have been
transported in large quantities to occupied areas under
the cloak of military requirements. As the control of
transportation and navigation along the Yangtze is in
their hands, the Japanese authorities have acquired a
rare opportunity for the extensive disposal of their
goods.

As the Yangtze is closely related to the
prosperity of the interior districts of China and with
a view to bringing about a complete control of navigation
along this river, the Japanese authorities have already
started preparations to establish a large shipping company
in Shanghai with a capital of $10,000,000 to engage
exclusively in navigation and transportation business
along the Yangtze River.

Recently a meeting was held at the Japanese
Club in Hongkew, at which a Chairman of the Board of
Directors of the company was elected and the date for its
formal inauguration was fixed. Its offices will be located
in the Mitsui Bank Building. In addition to the Yangtze,
the company, after its formal establishment, will also
assume control of navigation along other rivers. The
Powers, especially Britain and the U.S.A., will suffer
more losses.

At present only boats belonging to
the Nisshin Kisen Kaisha, a Japanese shipping concern,
are allowed to pass through the Kiangyin Boom; the
steamers of Butterfield & Swire and of the Indo-China
Steam Navigation Company, Ltd. can only sail between
Shanghai and Tiensunkiung (天生港). The Nisshin Kisen
Kaisha is building four 1,200-ton steamers for the
Yangtze service.

标准报及其他本地报纸 :-

长江航运

自南京和杭州陷落以来，江阴要塞以上的长江下游已禁止航运，但日本货物借军事需求之名，大量运往占领区。由于长江沿线的运输和航运控制权掌握在他们手中，日本当局获得了大规模倾销其货物的难得机会。

鉴于长江与中国内陆地区的繁荣息息相关，为了实现对这条河流航运的全面控制，日本当局已开始准备在上海成立一家大型航运公司，资本为一千万美元，专门从事长江沿线的航运和运输业务。

最近，在虹口日本俱乐部举行了一次会议，选举了该公司董事会主席，并确定了正式成立的日期。其办公地点将设在三井银行大楼。除长江外，该公司正式成立后还将接管其他河流的航运控制权。列强，尤其是英国和美国，将遭受更多损失。

目前，只有属于日本航运公司日清汽船株式会社的船只被允许通过江阴封锁线；太古洋行（Butterfield & Swire）和印度支那轮船公司（Indo-China Steam Navigation Company, Ltd.）的轮船只能在上海和天生港（Tiensunkiung）之间航行。日清汽船株式会社正在建造四艘1200吨级的轮船用于长江服务。

（手写批注：C 20/1  29.12）

December 21, 1938.
Morning Translation

Eastern Times :-

FORMATION OF A "YANGTSE SHIPPING COMPANY"

While strong representations are being lodged
with Japan by Britain, America, France and other Powers over
the re-opening of the Yangtse River, a "Yangtse Shipping
Company" (揚子江航業株式會社) has been organized by Japanese
merchants with a capital of $10,000,000. Its offices are
located in the Mitsui Bank building. It is said that
ostensibly the company is a Sino-Japanese enterprise but
in reality it will be operated by the Nisshin Kisen Kaisha.
According to information secured by our reporter,
the new company owns 16 vessels which will first be placed
for service along the Yangtse and later ten of the ships
will ply between North and South China. At present foreign
steamers plying the Yangtse are not allowed to proceed beyond
Hsin Kong (新港) on the Lower Yangtse, while the important
ports such as Tien Sung Kong (天生港), Kiangyin, etc., are
visited only by vessels belonging to the Nisshin Kisen Kaisha.
Therefore, all the foreign shipping companies are operating
at heavy loss due to the strong competition and greatly
reduced freight charges offered by Japanese vessels.

1938年12月21日。
晨间翻译

申报 :-

“扬子江航运公司”的成立

在英国、美国、法国和其他列强就重新开放长江一事向日本提出强烈抗议之际，日本商人组建了一家“扬子江航业株式会社”（Yangtse Shipping Company）（揚子江航業株式會社），资本为一千万美元。其办公地点位于三井银行大楼。据说该公司表面上是一家中日合资企业，但实际上将由日清汽船株式会社运营。据本报记者获得的消息，这家新公司拥有16艘船只，将首先投入长江服务，随后其中十艘船只将在华北和华南之间航行。目前，行驶在长江的外国轮船不被允许越过长江下游的新港（Hsin Kong），而天生港（Tien Sung Kong）、江阴等重要港口只有日清汽船株式会社的船只前往。因此，所有外国航运公司都因日本船只的激烈竞争和大幅降低的运费而遭受巨额亏损。

CHINA PRESS.

DEC 20 1938

Local Shipping
Little Changed
In November

Japanese Traffic Makes
Some Advance In
Shanghai

No changes of consequence occurred in Shanghai's shipping last month. The total shipping movement in this city's port, as expressed in tonnage, was about one per cent lower than the month before.

Total tonnage of vessels entering from and clearing for abroad, as well as from and for Chinese inland points, decreased somewhat, while there was a slight increase in shipping to and from other Chinese sea ports. Japan's share in Shanghai's shipping increased by but a small percentage.

The movements of local trade and shipping of late months failed to correspond. In October, Shanghai's foreign trade decreased but the shipping movement increased by 20 per cent. In November, local trade rose strongly in volume and value, but shipping failed to join in.

Altogether 131 vessels totaling 580,000 tons entered our port from abroad, i.e. 14 vessels and 21,792 tons less than the previous month. Under the British flag, there entered seven vessels and 5,000 tons less, while under the Rising Sun flag two more vessels and 21,000 more tons arrived. At a large distance followed, in the order of their importance in total tonnage, German, French, Italian, Norwegian, Netherlands, Danish, and Panama-registered ships. Not a single American vessel entered port, and but one vessel flying the Stars and Stripes cleared for abroad.

In the shipping between Shanghai and other Chinese sea ports, 231 vessels, displacing 282,926 tons arrived, i.e. one vessel and 2,800 tons more than during the month before. In this category, British ships entering port decreased by 10 vessels and 20,000 tons, while Japanese traffic increased by five vessels and 7,000 tons.

There followed, in the order of their relative importance, during the month under review, Norwegian, Italian, Netherlands, Danish, German, Portuguese, Panamanian, Greek, Swedish, French, and American vessels.

From Chinese inland places, 285 vessels of 171,066 tons entered our port, i.e. five vessels more, but 4,000 tons less than in October.

字林西报。

1938年12月20日

本地航运
11月变化不大

日本交通在上海
略有增长

上个月上海的航运没有发生重大变化。以吨位表示的本市港口总航运量比上月低约百分之一。

进出国外以及往返中国内陆港口的船舶总吨位略有下降，而往返其他中国海港的航运量略有增加。日本在上海航运中的份额仅增加了很小的百分比。

近几个月本地贸易和航运的走势未能对应。10月份，上海对外贸易下降，但航运量增加了20%。11月份，本地贸易在数量和价值上强劲增长，但航运并未随之增长。

共有131艘总计58万吨的船舶从国外进入本港，即比上月减少了14艘船舶和21,792吨。悬挂英国国旗的船舶进入数量减少了7艘，吨位减少了5,000吨，而悬挂旭日旗的船舶则增加了2艘，吨位增加了21,000吨。紧随其后的是德国、法国、意大利、挪威、荷兰、丹麦和巴拿马注册的船舶，按总吨位的重要性排序。没有一艘美国船舶进港，只有一艘悬挂星条旗的船舶离港前往国外。

在上海与其他中国海港之间的航运中，抵达船舶231艘，排水量282,926吨，即比上月多1艘船舶和2,800吨。在此类别中，进港的英国船舶减少了10艘和20,000吨，而日本交通增加了5艘船舶和7,000吨。

在本审查月份中，按相对重要性排序，随后是挪威、意大利、荷兰、丹麦、德国、葡萄牙、巴拿马、希腊、瑞典、法国和美国船舶。

从中国内陆地方，共有285艘总计171,066吨的船舶进入本港，即比10月份多5艘船舶，但少4,000吨。

DEC 1 5 1938

Nippon Tramp
Owners Talk
Combine Plan

Japanese owners of tramp steam-
ers met early this week in the
Astor House Hotel to discuss plans
for a combine operating on the
Yangtse, it was learned yesterday
by THE CHINA PRESS.
Although it had been reported
previously that the meeting was
convened in order to form a com-
pany holding monopoly navigation
rights on the Yangtse as a sub-
sidiary of the Central China
Development Company, investiga-
tions yesterday revealed that of
approximately 50 owners attending
the conference, few owned more
than two vessels.
It was reported that the owners
of these vessels formerly operated
under permits issued by the Japan-
ese army and navy authorities, but
owing to the withdrawal of these
permits, they had been compelled to
consider action to meet the new
situation.
No final decision was reached
at the meeting held at the beginning
of this week, and it is believed that
another meeting of owners will be
held in the near future, following
further negotiations with the
Japanese authorities.

1938年12月15日

日本不定期货轮船东
商谈联合计划

据《字林西报》昨日获悉，本周初，日本不定期货轮（tramp steamers）的船东们在汇中饭店（Astor House Hotel）举行会议，讨论在长江运营的联合经营计划。尽管此前有报道称，召开此次会议是为了成立一家作为华中开发公司子公司的企业，以垄断长江航行权，但昨日的调查显示，在出席会议的大约50名船东中，拥有两艘以上船只者寥寥无几。据报道，这些船只的船东此前依据日本陆海军当局颁发的许可证进行运营，但由于这些许可证被撤销，他们被迫考虑采取行动以应对新局面。在本周初举行的会议上未达成最终决定，据信在与日本当局进一步谈判后，近期将再次召开船东会议。

Discreet enquiries have been made in connection
with the report published in the local Chinese press of
December 12, 1938, to the effect that the Japanese authorities
have formed a new "Yangtse Shipping Company", which, it is
further stated, was inaugurated recently in the Astor House,
Whangpoo Road. So far no confirmation can be obtained of
this inaugural meeting but it has been learned that in
consequence of the Sino-Japanese hostilities along the
Yangtse River, Japanese steamship companies suffered serious
losses and following the occupation of the Wuhan area by
Japanese forces, the Government has been considering ways
and means for the resumption of navigation along the Yangtse
to be given exclusively to those Japanese interests which
have suffered.

This monopoly which would be a gold mine for
those companies has been religiously fought for by the
Japanese steamship companies concerned, and the Japanese
Government has decided to grant this monopoly to the Nisshin
Kisen Kaisha whose office is at 5 The Bund, because this
company has suffered the most in the hostilities. In
awarding this monopoly the Japanese Government stipulates
that the undertaking of navigation on the Yangtse by the
Nisshin Kisen Kaisha should be done in cooperation with
Chinese interests in order to guard against any international
question being brought up.

针对1938年12月12日当地中文报刊刊登的一则报道，已进行了审慎调查。该报道称日本当局已成立一家新的“长江轮船公司”，并进一步指出该公司最近在黄浦路汇中饭店举行了成立仪式。截至目前，尚无法证实此次成立会议，但据悉，由于沿长江地区的中日敌对行动，日本轮船公司遭受了严重损失；随着日军占领武汉地区，日本政府一直在考虑恢复长江航行的方法，并打算将其 exclusively（独家）授予那些遭受损失的日本利益方。

这一垄断权对相关公司而言无异于金矿，因此遭到了有关日本轮船公司的激烈争夺。日本政府已决定将此垄断权授予位于外滩5号的日清汽船株式会社（Nisshin Kisen Kaisha），因为该公司在敌对行动中受损最重。在授予此垄断权时，日本政府规定，日清汽船株式会社在长江的航运业务应与中方利益方合作进行，以避免引发任何国际问题。

日清汽船株式会社管理层的一位重要代表，在接到政府上述暗示后，

CHINA PRESS.

MAY 5 1939

Four Foreign
Vessels Held
By Japanese

German, British, Italian
Coasters Held Pending
Identification

Four more ships, two German,
one British and one Italian, have
been detained by the Japanese
authorities, it was learned here
yesterday.
Seized by the Japanese navy off
Haimen, river port on the northern
bank of the Yangtse, near the es-
tuary, the German-owned 40-ton
coaster s.s. Viking, returned here
yesterday morning under a Japan-
ese naval convoy. The ship was
tied up at buoys 17 and 18 off
Yangtszepoo.
The vessel was chartered by the
Yat Shing Shipping Agency, and
left Shanghai for Hsinhwa, near
Foochow, on April 29. When it was
seized on the day following its
departure, the ship was carrying
five passengers and a large quantity
of cargo, comprising largely cotton
yarn and flour.
Both the passengers and cargo are
believed to be detained still.
Another German vessel, the
Kondor, property of Reuter,
Brockelmann & Co., was also
reported to have been seized by
the Japanese navy while en route
to Haimen. The ship is now moor-
ed off Yangtszepoo, near the Viking.
At the Japanese press conference
yesterday, it was announced that
two steamers, one British and one
Italian, have been detained by the
Japanese naval authorities for in-
quiries into their legal status.
The British steamer Lalita, it was
admitted by the naval spokesman,
was detained off Foochow on April
27, but no details regarding the
charges brought, or the present
position of the vessel, were then in
his hands.

Italian Ship Detained
Brought up river under Japanese
instructions, the Italian river boat
Tembien, one of the well-known
Yangtse Delta traders, was tied up
at buoys downriver on Wednesday
evening, and is still being detained
pending investigations "into her
status." The passengers and cargo
of the Tembien, according to the
spokesman, had been landed.

四艘外籍船只
被日本扣押

德、英、意
沿海船只被扣以待核实身份

据本地昨日获悉，又有四艘船只，包括两艘德国船、一艘英国船和一艘意大利船，被日本当局扣押。

德国拥有的40吨级沿海蒸汽船“维京”号（s.s. Viking）在长江口附近北岸的海门港外被日本海军扣押，昨晨在日本海军护航下返回此地。该船停泊在杨树浦外的17号和18号浮筒处。

该船由亚兴轮船代理行（Yat Shing Shipping Agency）承租，于4月29日离开上海前往福州附近的新华（Hsinhwa）。在离境次日被扣押时，船上载有五名乘客和大量货物，主要包括棉纱和面粉。

据信乘客和货物目前仍被扣留。

另一艘德国船只“康多尔”号（Kondor），系罗伊特·布罗克尔曼公司（Reuter, Brockelmann & Co.）所有，据报道也在前往海门途中被日本海军扣押。该船目前停泊在杨树浦外，靠近“维京”号。

在昨日的日本记者招待会上，宣布有两艘轮船，一艘英国船和一艘意大利船，因调查其法律地位而被日本海军当局扣押。

海军发言人承认，英国轮船“拉利塔”号（Lalita）于4月27日在福州外海被扣押，但他当时手中没有关于指控细节或该船当前状况的资料。

根据日本方面的指令，“天变”号（Tembien）意大利内河轮船被带至上游，这是长江三角洲航线中知名的船只之一，于周三晚上停泊在下游浮筒处，目前仍因“调查其身份”而被扣押。据发言人称，“天变”号的乘客和货物已上岸。

MAY 5 1939

Shanghai-Wenchow Ship
Service Is Resumed

Wenchow Military Authorities Telegraph To Local
Firms Permitting Shipments; Business In
Southern Port Carried By Night

Local shipping firms are now
making preparations for the re-
sumption of Shanghai-Wenchow
shipping services, following the
receipt early this week of a report
that the Chinese defence authori-
ties have granted permission for
their so doing, it was reported yes-
terday.
The port has been closed to ship-
ping since April 23, when all the
steamers in the Oukiang River,
Wenchow, were ordered to leave
the boom areas. Since then, the
report stated, the Chinese military
authorities have completed their
defence works. The boom has
not been closed to-date, as apparent-
ly the situation in Wenchow at the
moment does not warrant the taking
of such a step.
With a view to facilitating the
transportation of cargo and the move-
ment of passengers, according to
the report, the Wenchow military
authorities have now wired local
shipping circles giving permission
for them to resume the Shanghai-
Wenchow shipping services.

Ningpo Service

The resumption of Shanghai-
Tinghai and Tinghai-Ningpo ship-
ping services has been permitted
since a week ago.
A great volume of cargo-carrying
trade is expected shortly, in view
of the large quantities of goods
now stored up in Wenchow, while
large quantities of merchandise are
awaiting shipment to Wenchow, it
was intimated in local shipping
circles yesterday.
In view of recent heavy Japanese
air raids over Ningpo and Wenchow,
the Chinese defence authorities
have instructed that business be
conducted by shops during the
night, instead of during the day,
according to information obtained
from local shipping circles. Native
banks in Ningpo have also been
instructed by their guild to conduct
business between the hours of 5
and 8 p.m., commencing April 29,
it was further stated.

1939年5月5日

上海-温州航运服务恢复

温州军事当局致电本地商行允许发货；南方港口业务改为夜间进行

据昨日报道，本周初收到消息称中国防卫当局已批准恢复上海至温州的航运服务，本地航运公司目前正在为此做准备。

自4月23日以来，该港口一直禁止航运，当时瓯江（Oukiang River，即温州）的所有轮船被命令离开封锁区。报道指出，此后中国军事当局已完成防御工事。截至目前，封锁线尚未封闭，因为显然温州目前的局势尚不需要采取此类措施。

报道指出，为了方便货物运输和人员流动，温州军事当局现已致电本地航运界，准许其恢复上海-温州航运服务。

宁波服务

自一周前起，上海-定海及定海-宁波的航运服务已获准恢复。

本地航运界昨日透露，鉴于目前温州囤积了大量货物，同时也有大量商品等待运往温州，预计不久将出现大量的货运贸易。

鉴于近期日本对宁波和温州的猛烈空袭，从本地航运界获得的消息表明，中国防卫当局已指示商店在夜间而非白天营业。此外，宁波的钱庄也接到同业公会的指示，自4月29日起，在下午5点至8点之间办理业务。

by an organization believed to have been known as the

关于附上的1939年5月5日《字林西报》（China Press）及其他本地外文报纸的摘录，这些报道提及日本海军当局扣留了多艘在中国沿海运营的外国船只，经调查，现就其中一艘涉事船只、意大利所有的沿海货轮“Tembien”号获取如下信息。
